title: Darius the Mede
summary: Darius the Mede is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Chaldaea, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only and is not converted to BC.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 790a
reign.note: Year cell "4176 3494". To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 2 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row.

reign.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxvi
reign.note: The existing Cyaxares record was not used. The “or” is Hales’s identification.

free_source_links.locator: 1830 second edition, four volumes, full view
